BiblicalUsage: Parshez means to expand, to spread out, to hold back. It appears once, in Job 26:9, where God holds back the face of His throne and spreads His cloud upon it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the God who spreads a cloud over His own throne is not hiding from us, He is showing us that His glory is too great to look at bare.
